anomalies.description: A man enters the store, approaches the counter area, and appears to interact with items on or near the counter; he then turns and moves toward the left side of the frame where a hand (likely another person's) extends into view from off-screen, possibly handing him an item or receiving something. His posture and movement—bending slightly, reaching toward the counter without clear transactional context, and the sudden appearance of an external hand—suggest possible concealment or unauthorized transfer of merchandise, consistent with shoplifting behavior.
